title: Leading engineering orgs
description: Growing leaders, building culture, and keeping teams steady through acquisitions, bankruptcy, and reorgs. The parts of the job that don't show up on the org chart.

title: Design engineering and frontend systems
description: Design systems, design-to-code pipelines, and frontend performance. What it takes to build a system people actually adopt, and what changes now that AI can generate UI.

title: Developer experience
description: Docs, tooling, and onboarding that make a whole org faster. Like letting engineers run local changes against real production data instead of mocks, or getting a new hire to a first PR in a day or two.

title: Learning AI in public
description: What I'm trying with AI agents, what works, and what breaks. A lab notebook, not a playbook.
